name: installguard
description: Looks up every new package before it installs: holds made-up names, typosquats, days-old releases and curl-into-shell for your answer, and lets the rest through.

hold.title: What is held
hold.description: flagged: only a command that names a flagged package or fetches from outside a registry. always: every command that adds a package the project does not already have.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: What counts as new, fresh and little used. relaxed: 7 days, 1 day, 100 downloads a week. balanced: 30 days, 3 days, 1,000. strict: 90 days, 7 days, 10,000.

unreachable.title: When a registry cannot be reached
unreachable.description: allow: the command runs and the pane notes it was not checked. hold: the command waits for your answer.

toasts.title: Say when a package passes
toasts.description: Show a short toast with a package's age and weekly downloads when nothing about it is flagged.
